title: CUTS PILLS vs BULK PILLS
directVerdict: CUTS PILLS is the better fit for thermogenic and cutting, while BULK PILLS is the better fit for strength and power.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only CUTS PILLS discloses: L-Carnitine Fumarate: 750 mg per full serving; Dandelion Extract: 500 mg per full serving; Beta Phenylethylamine HCl: 200 mg per full serving; Caffeine Anhydrous: 175 mg per full serving; Guarana Extract: 100 mg per full serving; L-Theanine: 100 mg per full serving; Theobromine: 100 mg per full serving; Bitter Orange Extract: 50 mg per full serving.

Only BULK PILLS discloses: Vitamin D3: 125 mcg per full serving; Magnesium: 30 mg per full serving; Zinc: 5.5 mg per full serving; Fadogia Agrestis: 500 mg per full serving; Bulbine Natalensis: 500 mg per full serving; Tongkat Ali: 400 mg per full serving; Spilanthes Acmella: 300 mg per full serving; Inositol: 200 mg per full serving.

CUTS PILLS caffeine: CUTS PILLS lists stimulant ingredients, but the verified source set does not confirm a total caffeine amount. BULK PILLS caffeine: BULK PILLS is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: CUTS PILLS: CUTS PILLS: A capsule-format thermogenic and energy product for customers who do not want a powdered pre-workout. The easiest concrete points are Capsule delivery, Single no-flavor SKU, Caffeine, guarana, and theobromine combination. BULK PILLS: BULK PILLS: A capsule-format strength and testosterone-support product. The easiest concrete points are No flavor decision, 30 servings, Fadogia, Bulbine, Tongkat Ali, and Shilajit.
tradeoffs: CUTS PILLS: A stimulant-free request; Customers asking for a confirmed total-caffeine number until the guarana contribution is verified
BULK PILLS: A pre-workout energy request
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: CUTS PILLS for thermogenic and cutting; BULK PILLS for strength and power.
